lede: BGK bonds for the COVID-19 Fund (FPC) carry an explicit State Treasury guarantee, i.e. the same credit as POLGBs. Prices are thin Catalyst retail closes (1 Jun 2026; FPC0231 traded a single bond), so levels are indicative. Spread vs POLGB = yield minus the fitted POLGB curve for the same cash flows; ASW = yield minus PLN IRS.

takeaways_html: FPC fixed lines trade ~14-27bp over the POLGB curve (average 20bp); widest ASW FPC0235 at 112bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: FPC0630 (+27bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK sold PLN 0.94bn of FPC on 28 May (demand 1.62bn) plus 0.05bn; its first FPC switch is set for 18 Jun (buys back FPC0427); a POLSTR-based FPC floater is planned for Q3.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
sources: Catalyst closes of 1 Jun 2026 via biznesradar historical pages; BGK FPC 2026 plan (reported 24 Sep 2025); FPC 2025 plan amendment (15 Oct 2025); PAP on the cancelled 9 Dec 2025 auction; Pekao market-maker agreement (13 Nov 2025). Yields recomputed with annual ACT/ACT coupons on each bond's anniversary dates.
